data.title: Israelis fly from around world to vote in pivotal election

data.title: Chao Phraya Dam to reduce discharge to 1,800 cu m/sec Wednesday

data.title: The 6th Royal Cliff Junior Tennis Thailand Championship Serves Up Exciting Weekend

Open to young players aged 4–16, the championship offers more than a chance to compete. It is an opportunity to test their skills, gain valuable national ranking points, build confidence and experience the excitement of competing in a professionally organised tournament.

data.title: Global deforestation slowed in 2025 but surged in Congo basin: study

data.title: Pat Bradley: A lovely swing to remember
data.description: The swing that God gave Pat Bradley was a thing of beauty. It was a lovely rhythmic motion that never seemed to change, whatever club she was using. I found her practising at the Florida club she called home at the time. After a while, she spotted me watching her go through her practice routine and said hello, she caught my English accent and asked me many questions. I had always wanted to meet her as I had admired her swing ever since I saw it on TV.
